description: CONFIRMED mapped defect #14: Save Procedure POSTs /api/visits without `complaints`; the backend replies 400 ["complaints must be an array"] and the page shows a native alert("Failed to save procedure. Please try again."). Retrying can never succeed. The same payload with "complaints": [] succeeds via the API (verified - visit cmw6ep04m009d7dc16tm7rdp7).
expected: Procedure saved and appears in Procedure History.
actual: Nothing can ever be saved from the Procedures page; generic native alert.
suggested_fix: Send complaints: [] (or make it @IsOptional in CreateVisitDto); replace alert() with an inline/toast error that shows the reason.

criterion: Defaults carry the user / wrong-patient risk
description: "Patient *" silently preselects the first patient in the list (here a test patient "UXW MgrToast") from a plain Select of 14+ names with no search; "Doctor *" defaults to Dr. Praneeta Jain although Dr. Shravya is signed in.
expected: Patient empty with a searchable picker; doctor defaults to the signed-in doctor.
actual: Procedure would be recorded on an arbitrary first patient unless noticed.
suggested_fix: Start with no patient selected, use the patient search combobox, default doctor to current user.

description: CONFIRMED mapped defect #15: "View Details" on a history card does nothing (no dialog, DOM unchanged). "Load & Edit" switches to New Procedure but resets Session No. to 1, clears Additional Notes, and keeps the previous unsaved shot counts (15200/16850) and body parts (Chin+Neck) instead of the loaded session's values (13000/15200, Chin); saving would create a new visit, not edit.
expected: View Details opens the record; Load & Edit loads exactly that record and updates it.
actual: Dead button; Load & Edit mixes stale form state with the loaded record.
suggested_fix: Render a details dialog; reset the form fully before loading; PATCH when editing.

description: CONFIRMED mapped defect #16: Fotona Starwalker parameters list "Area" twice (rows 1 and 8); typing "Upper lip" in the second Area row also fills the first.
suggested_fix: Remove the duplicate key or give rows unique keys.

description: CONFIRMED edge case: switching machine from Soprano to Fotona keeps the old per-pass values (Area pass 2-3 still "Beard line"), and after Load & Edit the Soprano grid shows "Upper lip" typed on Fotona.
expected: Switching machine clears or scopes parameters per machine.

description: CONFIRMED mapped defect #17: the Procedure History card shows patient, date, machine and doctor only - no session number and none of the per-pass parameters (Fluence 10 saved in the parameters grid is not displayed).
expected: Card shows session no. and key parameters.

description: Per-pass inputs are ~66px wide at 1280 (and ~40px on mobile): entered values are clipped ("Bearc" for "Beard line") and placeholders truncate ("fluenc", "spot s"); no units are shown for Fluence (J/cm²) or Spot Size.
expected: Inputs fit realistic values; units in the row header.
suggested_fix: Fewer visible passes by default (add-pass button), wider inputs, unit labels.
